companyDescription: Cell therapy · Deramiocel for Duchenne muscular dystrophy — thesis materially RECOVERED (not broken) since the Aug 13 report: FDA extended the PDUFA to Nov 22, 2026 for a BLA narrowed to the upper-limb-function endpoint the adcomm was directionally supportive on
priceNote: Live $8.87 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Oct 26) used $5.83, a +52.1% drift that already exceeds the old Base target ($8.16). Scenarios are re-derived from the live price. The PDUFA is Nov 22, in 11 days.
summary: Refresh: the deramiocel PDUFA (narrowed to upper-limb function in DMD, the HOPE-3 primary endpoint, with 24-month OLE data in the major amendment) is confirmed for Nov 22, 2026, 11 days out. The stock has run +52% since Oct 26 and blew through the old Base target, so scenarios are rebuilt from $8.87: Base +40% (~$12.4). The 9-3 negative adcomm (Jul 29) on the original indication remains the key risk. Cash of ~$198.5M covers at least 12 months, and manufacturing is launch-ready. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call. Do not chase; size 2%.

catalysts.name: Deramiocel PDUFA — upper-limb function (DMD)
catalysts.description: Target action date Nov 22, 2026 after a major amendment (24-month HOPE-3 OLE data). The adcomm voted 9-3 against the original indication (Jul 29).

risks: FDA adcomm voted 9-3 against efficacy for the original cardiomyopathy indication (Jul 2026) — the narrowed indication still faces real approval risk.
Securities class actions over the early-September disclosures.
A second CRL (after Jul 2025's -33% day) would likely force a dilutive raise.
The narrowed indication caps peak sales.
Launch execution for a novel cell therapy.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset cell-therapy biotech; the FDA outcome dominates and rates matter mainly for the cost of a launch raise.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — the PDUFA is 11 days out after a +52% run that has already used up the old Base. Do not chase into a 9-3 negative-adcomm decision. Measured core at-catalyst median is -6.9% (n=54), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Reverse run-up: CAPR fell ~32% since Sep 29 ($8.62 → $5.83) amid securities suits over early-September disclosures.

postWin.note: CAPR's own Dec 2025 Phase 3 HOPE-3 readout is the most direct precedent (+300% in 2 trading days on positive DMD data), but a November approval of an already-partly-priced-in narrowed claim would likely produce a smaller pop than a surprise data win. SRPT's narrow-label DMD approval (Jun 2023) is a cautionary comp — even an approval can disappoint if the label is restrictive.

postLose.note: CAPR's own Jul 30, 2026 reaction to the adcomm's 9-3 vote is the direct precedent (-36% in one day). A second rejection/CRL on the narrowed upper-limb indication in November would likely be at least as severe, possibly worse given it would be the drug's second regulatory setback on the same program.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. A binary after a +52% run, with a negative adcomm history.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If FDA issues a second CRL, exit on day 1.

comparableCases.event: FDA extends PDUFA to Nov 22, 2026 after BLA amended to upper-limb-function-only claim
comparableCases.note: The event this refresh corrects for — a genuine, gradual recovery from the post-adcomm low, not a single-day pop. Same drug, same company, direct precedent for how the market re-prices a partially-derisked binary outcome.

comparableCases.event: FDA advisory committee votes 9-3 against DMD-cardiomyopathy effectiveness
comparableCases.note: The event that originally broke the thesis. Direct precedent for the downside if the Nov 22 PDUFA disappoints again.

comparableCases.event: Elevidys FDA accelerated approval (first DMD gene therapy) — restrictive label triggers a same-day drop despite the approval itself
comparableCases.note: A reminder that a narrow-label 'win' can still disappoint the market — CAPR's own narrowed upper-limb-only ask carries similar risk even in an approval scenario.
